children: Chewy reported second-quarter fiscal 2026 results with net sales of $3.33 billion, up 7.3% year‑over‑year, and net income of $80.5 million. Adjusted diluted earnings per share were $0.36 and adjusted EBITDA totaled $226.7 million, driven by continued autoship strength and customer growth. Management raised full‑year revenue and profitability outlook and will host a conference call to discuss results.
Revenue (Net sales): $3.33 billion for Q2 FY2026, up 7.3% year over year.
Gross profit: $1,011.2 million with gross margin of 30.4% (consistent year over year).
Operating income (Income from operations): $92.0 million for the quarter.
Net income: $80.5 million for the quarter; net margin 2.4%.
Adjusted diluted earnings per share: $0.36; Adjusted EBITDA: $226.7 million (Adjusted EBITDA margin 6.8%).
Customer base expansion: Active customers increased to 21.705 million, a 3.8% year‑over‑year rise (excludes Modern Animal additions).
Autoship momentum: Autoship customer sales were $2,817.2 million, representing 84.6% of net sales and driving recurring revenue strength.
Per‑customer engagement: Net sales per active customer rose to $602, a 1.9% increase versus prior year.
Strategic investments and M&A: Acquisition activity contributed to the quarter (SmartPak and Modern Animal noted), and management signaled ongoing investments to deepen customer engagement.
Operational cash generation: Net cash provided by operating activities was $245.9 million for the 26‑week period, supporting capital spending and share repurchases.
This is an AI-powered summary. It may contain inaccuracies. Consider verifying important information with the source. Please note this summary is solely based on documents filed with the SEC.
